title: Loading the demo from the welcome screen can delete a member's own routines and body records without saying so
what: After 'Remove demo data' a member's own routines, body weight, measurements and photos stay on the phone. If they then tap 'Load demo data instead' with no workout of their own, the sheet says only 'You can remove it any time.' and the load erases all of it. With workouts kept, it names only the workouts.
expected: The welcome sheet names everything that will be deleted (as the Settings demo switch already does) and is shown as a warning whenever anything of the member's is on the phone.
who: members who removed the demo and then load it again
how_often: rare: only after a demo was removed
fix_line: Use the Settings demo wording on the welcome sheet and warn whenever own data exists
